mentions.name: Alternative-security blockchain (no hashing or stake)
mentions.description: A blockchain designed to achieve security without relying on hashing (proof-of-work), stake (proof-of-stake), or authority. Still in progress; the builder plans to share it on Hacker News when done.
mentions.source_excerpt: A blockchain that uses neither hashing nor stake for security. (And not authority.) I will post here when done.
